## Explore Player Putting Performance

Use the interactive tool below to explore putting performance across individual PGA Tour tournaments. 

### How to use this interactive plot:
- **Hover** over any point to inspect the specific tournament name, date, total putts, and average putts per round.
- **Click** on a player's name in the legend on the right to toggle them on or off.
- **Double-click** on a player's name to isolate only that golfer.
- **Click and drag** on the chart area to zoom into any specific season or time window.

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactive-explorer
#| fig-height: 6

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load tournament data
pga_data <- read_csv("data/pga_putts_per_round.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Prominent players across the 2015-2023 span
featured_players <- c(
  "Scottie Scheffler", "Rory McIlroy", "Xander Schauffele",
  "Collin Morikawa", "Viktor Hovland", "Patrick Cantlay",
  "Wyndham Clark", "Sahith Theegala", "Hideki Matsuyama",
  "Jordan Spieth", "Justin Thomas", "Tony Finau"
)

explore_df <- pga_data |>
  filter(player %in% featured_players)

# Base ggplot
p <- ggplot(explore_df, aes(
  x = date,
  y = putts_per_round,
  color = player,
  text = paste0(
    "<b>", player, "</b><br>",
    "Tournament: ", tournament, "<br>",
    "Date: ", date, "<br>",
    "Putts/Round: ", round(putts_per_round, 2), "<br>",
    "Total Putts: ", total_putts, " (", total_rounds, " rounds)"
  )
)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 28.75, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
  geom_line(aes(group = player), alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(24, 34, by = 2)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(
    title = "Interactive Tournament Putting (2015–2023)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Average Putts Per Round",
    color = "Player"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Convert to interactive plotly widget
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    legend = list(
      orientation = "v",
      y = 0.5,
      title = list(text = "<b>Click to Filter:</b>")
    ),
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white")
  )
```

The dashed gray line represents the Tour-wide median of **28.75 putts per round**. Notice how even perennial major contenders oscillate above and below the baseline from week to week.
